steps.en: Install the skill into Claude Code or Codex
steps.zh: 把 Skill 装进 Claude Code 或 Codex

steps.en: Auto-fires on Chinese writing tasks from its description
steps.zh: 按 description 在中文写作任务上自动触发

steps.en: Hand over the draft and name the task mode
steps.zh: 交出稿件，说明是撰写、改写还是校对
steps.code: Use $tech-doc-style-chinese to rewrite this Chinese technical copy.

steps.en: Marks facts, limits and machine-readable spans as no-touch boundaries
steps.zh: 先把事实和机器可读内容划成不可改动边界

steps.en: Reads the one reference matching the content type
steps.zh: 按内容类型读取对应的那份参考规则

steps.en: Rewrites by rule priority, then runs the copy linter
steps.zh: 按规则优先级改写，再跑内置检查器

value.en: Chinese docs that read native: facts and code untouched, warnings gated by a CI-runnable linter
value.zh: 拿到像母语者写的中文文档，事实与代码不动，警告由可进 CI 的检查器把关

sources: README.md — npx install commands, explicit invocation example, Claude Code auto-trigger note
SKILL.md — frontmatter description, 规则优先级, 编辑流程, 参考资料路由
